effect: The display completed the workshop opening, and a rider from Tin Row found it using the local address.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the local address work for an actual visitor, without pretending the corporate policy had changed.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting and installing the local delivery display gave the opening a concrete payoff: someone could find the workshop without a paid lookup.

leastWorthwhile.text: Opening the shutter felt like a predictable access step, though seeing the stocked cupboard ready was a nice touch.

surprise.text: Sal adding “AND TODAY” to the sign made the future-facing promise feel immediate.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the offered combinations had clear purposes, although choosing from compatible options didn't involve discovering the recipes.

continue.text: I would continue for the neighborhood story and its practical payoffs, though I'd hope for more meaningful choices than this short, largely predictable closing sequence offered.
